hero.infoHiver: Right now: roof snow removal, steam ice dam removal and Christmas lights.
hero.infoAutomne: Right now: fall gutter cleaning and Christmas light installation.
hero.infoPrintemps: Right now: soft washing, windows and spring gutter cleaning.
hero.alt: Snowy house at blue hour, thick snow at the roof edge

saison.titre: The right service, in the right season.
saison.texte: Your home doesn't need the same care in November as in May. Pick a season: here's what we do for you.

jauge.texte: Enter how much snow is on your roof and what you notice inside: we'll tell you if it's time to call.

vapeur.texte: An ice dam traps meltwater at the roof edge, and the water ends up seeping in: stained ceilings, dripping soffits. PMG removes it with commercial-grade steam equipment, without damaging shingles, flashing, gutters or soffits.
vapeur.jamais: What never goes on your roof
vapeur.delai: In peak season, we're often there the same day or within 24 to 48 hours, depending on demand and the weather.

lumieres.titre: Your Christmas lights, no ladder for you.
lumieres.texte: Commercial-grade C9 LED bulbs on custom-cut wire: PMG designs, installs, removes in spring and stores your lights until next season.
lumieres.note: Change your colour combination every year at no extra cost.

avantApres.texte: Soft washing: the pressure of a garden hose and non-toxic, biodegradable products. Stains are mostly mould, algae and bacteria, on the north side and in the shade.

securite.titre: Insured and trained for working at heights.

avis.texte: Neighbours from Ottawa, Gatineau, Nepean and beyond. A few words, just as they wrote them.
avis.ruban: They trusted us with their roof, gutters, windows or lights

zone.texte: From Shawville to Saint-Jérôme, from Wakefield to Kemptville: 52 communities in Quebec and 45 in Ontario, setting out from L'Ange-Gardien.

fin.texte: Requests sent through the form usually get an answer within minutes; by text, it's often even faster.

jauge.pluie: Rain is forecast after the snow
jauge.ok: Below the 24-inch benchmark. Keep an eye on the weather, especially if rain follows the snow.
jauge.attention: Getting close to the benchmark: plan a snow removal, especially before rain.
jauge.depasse: At the 24-inch benchmark: snow removal is generally recommended.
jauge.pluieConseil: Rain forecast after a snowfall: clearing the roof is advised before the rain makes the snow heavier.
jauge.alerte: Warning sign: have your roof checked and cleared right away.
jauge.note: Benchmarks from PMG Maintenance's snow removal page. Every roof is different: if in doubt, ask a professional.
jauge.coupe: Cross-section of a roof: the snow layer follows the chosen depth

securite.cnesst: Every worker is covered by the CNESST in Quebec and the WSIB in Ontario.
securite.hauteur: A crew trained and certified in Working at Heights, with safety training.
securite.soumission: A written quote before the work, an invoice and a receipt after.
securite.proprio: An owner-run business, with the owner on site.

offres.texte: Limited-time offers, one code per home or business. Add the code to your estimate request.
offres.deuxServices: $25 off when you combine gutter cleaning and window cleaning.
offres.voisins: $25 for you and $25 for your neighbour: same service, same day.
offres.voisinsDetail: Gutters and downspouts, windows (25 or more) or a complete exterior wash.
offres.reference: $50 off your next service for every client you refer.
offres.referenceDetail: The new client enters your name in their request.

toiture.surtitre: Roof snow removal and ice dam removal
toiture.texte: Heavy snow, ice dams, icicles above the front door: PMG works on residential and commercial roofs across Ottawa-Gatineau, by hand and with steam.
toiture.chiffreTexte: of build-up: the point at which snow removal is generally recommended.
toiture.info: In peak season: often the same day or within 24 to 48 hours.
toiture.alt: Winter roof edge: ice dam, icicles and steam in the sun

signes.neige: Too much snow on the roof
signes.note: An ice dam should come off as soon as it forms: the bigger it gets, the more water seeps in.

jauge.texte: Snow removal is generally recommended when build-up approaches 24 inches, and before rain is forecast after a snowfall. Check where you stand.

deneigement.texte: Manual, controlled snow removal that takes the weight off without damaging the roof.
deneigement.quand: When should you clear it? When build-up approaches 24 inches, and before rain is forecast after a snowfall.
deneigement.eviter: What we avoid: metal shovels, aggressive scraping, clearing down to the shingles and working without safety equipment.
deneigement.alt: Clearing snow from a roof with a shovel

vapeur.texte: Commercial-grade steam melts the ice in a controlled way, where a hammer would crack the shingles.
vapeur.aussi: Also: flat or sloped roofs, balconies, gates, stairs and skylights, plus concrete slabs and formwork on commercial sites.
vapeur.calcium: Calcium-based products help prevent an ice dam, not remove one.
vapeur.alt: Ice dam melted with steam at the roof edge

prix.texte: It depends on roof access, build-up, safety requirements and the time needed. You get a clear written quote before the work, then an invoice and a receipt.

fin.texte: Text us a photo of your roof or fill in the request: the written quote is free.

lumieres.texte: Pick your colours and the facade lights up. Commercial-grade C9 LED bulbs along your roofline, taken down in spring.
lumieres.alt: Snowy house facade at dusk, roofline lit with the chosen bulbs
lumieres.simulation: Simulation: the bulbs are drawn over the illustration.

couleurs.texte: Faceted C9 bulbs: bright, even and energy-efficient. One colour or several; change the combination every year at no extra cost. Other colours and styles are available by special order.

service.texte: You buy nothing and climb nothing: the lights and equipment remain the property of PMG Maintenance.

garantie.titre: A bulb goes out? We come back.
garantie.texte: During the warranty period, a faulty bulb or an adjustment is fixed at no extra cost, under the terms of the service warranty and weather permitting.

fin.texte: Availability is limited: ask for your free estimate now.

lavage.texte: Soft washing cleans siding, soffits, roofs and concrete with the pressure of a garden hose and non-toxic, biodegradable products.
lavage.alt: Freshly washed white vinyl siding with droplets in the spring sun

bassePression.p1: Less risk for your surfaces and less water than high-pressure washing.
bassePression.p2: Black and green stains are mostly mould, algae and bacteria, more visible on the north side and in the shade.
bassePression.p3: Equipment that lets us work at heights safely.
bassePression.c2: Gutters, downspouts, fascia, soffits, siding and doors

gouttieres.texte: Full of debris, they overflow, sag, freeze and let water seep into the roof, walls and foundation.
gouttieres.verifs: Every cleaning, we check three things
gouttieres.frequence: Once a year, in the fall, is usually enough. A second cleaning in spring or summer helps if pines or maples are nearby.
gouttieres.parefeuilles: Gutter guards? None truly replace cleaning: debris sticks on top, and shingle granules build up even without trees.

vitres.texte: Residential, commercial and institutional windows, plus post-construction and post-renovation cleaning. Once or twice a year, for a brighter home or a storefront that invites people in.
vitres.alt: Large clean window reflecting the sky

fin.texte: Ask for your free estimate: gutters, washing, windows or all of the above.
